## Irish Betting Licence Index
Current value: 42 (licences in force, week commencing 10 November 2026).
Definition: total GRAI licences in force (remote betting + remote betting intermediary + in-person betting). Casino licences: 0 (expected 2027–2028).
Weekly history (cumulative): 29 Jun: 13 · 6 Jul: 15 · 13 Jul: 16 · 20 Jul: 17 · 27 Jul: 21 · 10 Aug: 26 · 24 Aug: 30 · 31 Aug: 32 · 7 Sep: 35 · 14 Sep: 37 · 21 Sep: 38 · 28 Sep: 41 · 12 Oct: 42

## Key Irish gambling statistics (sourced)
- ~75% of Irish adults gamble at least monthly; ~€5.5bn annual spend (ESRI, 2023 study, n=2,850)
- 3.3% of adults (~130,000) show problem gambling; 7.1% (~279,000) moderate risk (ESRI)
- 77% of recent bettors bet online; ~80% hold a betting account; 54% a second one (ESRI, Nov 2026, n=1,000)
- Online betting stakes €911.2m in Q1 2026 vs €570.3m retail (Revenue data)
- Industry GGR €1.17–2.57bn (2025); ~€171m betting duty; 684 betting shops, down from 1,385 in 2008 (GRAI annual report)
Full sources with URLs: https://craicbet.com/pages/ireland-gambling-statistics
